name: Image Space Outline Generation
definition: A pixel-based method to generate simple outlines by extracting edges from depth or normal maps, observing that depth differences are minimal between adjacent pixels of a single object and large between objects, and normals vary smoothly across a single surface but show discontinuity between surfaces.
summary: Image Space Outline Generation renders non-photorealistic outlines by detecting depth or normal discontinuities in screen-space buffers, offering a faster, simpler alternative to volumetric gradient methods.
